reasoning: A hybrid strategy combines autonomous reasoning with validated explainability tools to ensure both domain-aware interpretation and rigorous numerical attribution. Autonomous analysis helps ground feature importance in biological and medical context, while XAI tools provide statistically robust, model-agnostic feature importance scores. This combination increases confidence in identifying truly responsible features for the benign prediction.

autonomous_tasks.expected_output: A comparative insight on how input values differ between classes and which features show larger discrepancies

tool_selection.reasoning: All four tools are well-suited for tabular data and provide complementary perspectives on feature importance. SHAP offers global interpretability grounded in game theory, LIME provides local interpretability through approximating a simple model, Integrated Gradients offer gradient-based attribution from baseline, and sensitivity analysis quantifies the effect of removing each feature. Together, they validate and cross-check feature significance across multiple modalities.
